villa_snapshot: Villa snapshot

Nestled within a tranquil, gated hillside retreat, this luxurious pet-friendly 4-BHK villa is crafted for those who appreciate quiet sophistication and refined details. Encircled by pine-clad slopes and sweeping valley views, the villa showcases Alpine-inspired architecture enhanced with natural stone accents that seamlessly echo its surroundings. Cobbled pathways lined with manicured planters and softly glowing vintage street lamps create a serene ambience—perfectly explored via a luxury golf cart.

Just outside the entrance, a private swimming pool takes centre stage, highlighted by a striking mosaic feature wall. A wooden deck surrounds the pool, complete with sun loungers and a refreshing outdoor shower for leisurely afternoons.

Inside, the living room exudes understated elegance with plush beige sofas and chic armchairs. A dazzling crystal chandelier crowns the space, complemented by tasteful décor elements such as golden accents and delicate floral arrangements. The adjoining dining area features a six-seater table paired with upholstered high-back chairs, while the open kitchen impresses with high-gloss taupe and cream cabinetry, a central island, and premium finishes throughout.

Every bedroom is framed by floor-to-ceiling windows that capture expansive views, including a charming attic room with its own balcony. The first-floor master bedroom opens onto a private balcony and features an ensuite bathroom fitted with a temperature-controlled toilet seat for added comfort.

Indulge in a spa-like retreat with a jacuzzi positioned beside a large window overlooking the hills, alongside a wooden steam room equipped with seating and dual controls for personalised temperature and humidity.

The spacious terrace offers breathtaking 360-degree hill views, inviting guests to unwind in wicker armchairs with striped cushions under the open sky. Vibrant blooms add bursts of colour, enhancing the sense of calm and escape.
A premium clubhouse for peaceful escapes and memorable evenings, with a serene pool, elegant bar, and more for refined indulgence.

Completing the experience is a dedicated 5-star hospitality team, always available with warmth and attentive care, truly reflecting the spirit of Atithi Devo Bhava. From a butler and chef-on-call to a premium welcome hamper and a thoughtful farewell gift, every detail is thoughtfully curated to ensure guests feel indulged, relaxed, and truly at home.
Aqua Bay

A private pool sits just off the villa’s entrance, set against a striking mosaic feature wall. Encircled by a wooden deck, the poolside area is complete with sun loungers and a refreshing outdoor shower.
Spa Sanctuary

For a spa-like experience, relax in the jacuzzi by a large window with stunning hill views. Complementing this setting is a wooden steam room with a bench and dual dials for custom temperature and humidity controls.
Outdoor Serenity
A charming terrace garden adorned with ornamental plants and a cosy patio set, offering serene views of the landscape.
Sky Lounge
Enjoy 360° hill views from the spacious terrace, where wicker armchairs with striped cushions offer a relaxing spot under the open sky, surrounded by vibrant flowers.
The Imperial Lounge

The living room, anchored by plush beige sofas and stylish armchairs, radiates understated elegance. A statement crystal chandelier glimmers overhead, reflecting off wood-paneled accents and stylish decor, with a powder room nearby.
Bedroom 1 Crestwood Suite

A regal retreat on the first floor, this suite boasts floor-to-ceiling windows framing breathtaking views, a plush king-sized bed, tan leather bench, central hot & cold AC, a 62” TV, private balcony, and an ensuite bathroom.
Bathroom 1
Designed with a shower, temperature-controlled toilet seat, signature organic toiletries, plush towels, and a hairdryer.
Bedroom 2 Vista Royale
Set against scenic hill vistas, this first-floor retreat includes a king-sized bed, a lounge chair with an ottoman, and an ensuite bathroom.
Bathroom 2
Features a shower, soft towels, a hairdryer, and premium organic essentials.
Bedroom 3 The Willow Room
This ground-floor suite blends elegance with modern comfort, featuring a king-sized bed, armchairs, floor-to-ceiling glass windows with hill views, and an ensuite bathroom.
Bathroom 3
Equipped with a shower, soft towels, a hairdryer, and organic toiletries.
Bedroom 4 Ridge Loft
Located on the second floor, this cosy attic features a king-sized bed, large sliding doors opening to a scenic balcony, and an ensuite bathroom for complete comfort.
Bathroom 4
Offers a shower, soft towels, premium toiletries, and a hairdryer.
Dining Delight

The open-concept kitchen features state-of-the-art appliances including a refrigerator, oven, microwave, and chimney. A central island complements the space, while an elegant six-seater dining table provides the perfect setting for savouring meals.
